Title: Puppet Extension is now available for Azure

Body.Content: Puppet Enterprise is IT automation software that gives system administrators the power to easily automate repetitive tasks, quickly deploy critical applications, and proactively manage infrastructure.  The Puppet Agent installed with this Azure extension fetches configurations from a Puppet Master server, and reports events to the Puppet Enterprise Console, a graphical interface that visualizes infrastructure changes across the organization. This extension is published by Puppet Labs.
Body.Markdown:
Puppet Enterprise is IT automation software that gives system administrators the power to easily automate repetitive tasks, quickly deploy critical applications, and proactively manage infrastructure. The Puppet Agent installed with this Azure extension fetches configurations from a Puppet Master server, and reports events to the Puppet Enterprise Console, a graphical interface that visualizes infrastructure changes across the organization.

This extension is published by Puppet Labs .
